summary.text: Luke Searle is the Republican candidate for the Utah House of Representatives, District 59, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Democrat Celeste Johnson for a seat with no incumbent.
Searle is a high school teacher who, in a Ballotpedia survey, said he serves on the Wasatch County Council.

paragraphs.text: Searle earned a high school diploma from Wasatch High School.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in the Heber Valley by a single mother who is a public school teacher, and that he and his wife are raising three children there.
He said he teaches business and marketing at Wasatch High School, works with students in the Wasatch CAPS program, and is finishing a master's degree in education at Southern Utah University.

Searle said that on the Wasatch County Council he voted against the transit sales-tax increase, helped stop multiple property tax increases, and supported conservation easements preserving about 600 acres.
He listed protecting open space, farmland and water, easing the cost of living for families, and keeping decisions local among his key campaign messages.
